title: QMoE: Sub-1-Bit Compression of Trillion Parameter Models
problem: Trillion-parameter models require prohibitive storage and memory bandwidth for inference. Achieving sub-1-bit quantization while maintaining accuracy is challenging, especially for Mixture of Experts architectures.
motivation: Extreme model compression enables deployment on resource-constrained devices and substantially reduces inference cost and latency.
method: Quantizes model weights to sub-1-bit precision using techniques specialized for Mixture of Experts architectures. Leverages sparse expert activation patterns and applies per-expert quantization parameters to maintain accuracy at extreme compression ratios.
key_novelty: First to achieve practical sub-1-bit quantization on trillion-parameter models by exploiting MoE sparsity patterns.
contributions: Sub-1-bit quantization method for trillion-parameter models
MoE-aware compression exploiting sparse expert activation
Maintains model accuracy at extreme compression ratios
Enables efficient inference deployment on resource-constrained hardware

metrics.accuracy: model accuracy maintained at extreme compression

limitations: Specific accuracy metrics and hardware evaluation details not available from title alone.
